title: Exploratory public GitHub technical-footprint negative control
sampling: Purposeful eight named film/VFX/animation organizations with verified public GitHub profile; first result returned by GitHub plugin query org:<name> fork:false; default first result may reflect relevance and isn't stable random sample.
unit: one top-returned public GitHub repository per organization; README.md only
method: Manual document-purpose coding, checked first-party repository README when retrievable. Not company-level score and not a test of ARD registries or AI agent referrals.

coding_rubric.readme_readable: GitHub Contents API returned README.md UTF-8 body; absence means path unavailable only
coding_rubric.technical_project_documentation: README's principal object is technical tool/library/method rather than an evaluated commercial production case
coding_rubric.production_service_applicability: Explicit buyer-specific use/when, contraindications or production requirements
coding_rubric.buyer_production_brief_handoff: Explicit route for a prospective client to submit a production job brief, distinct from support or developer contact
coding_rubric.commercial_case_credit_with_release_stag: Client project, studio's scoped role, and final/released/R&D status stated together

reproducibility.query_template: GitHub plugin search_repositories query='org:<org> fork:false', org=<org>, per_page=10; choose first returned
reproducibility.readme_template: GitHub plugin fetch_file repository_full_name=<selected>, path='README.md'; SHA stored
biases: purposefully selected organizations known for VFX/animation
first returned result is a code-repo search result, not canonical studio service card
GitHub search order can shift and be affected by access/filters
main studio websites and commercial pages not inspected
technical repository samples are a negative control, not a market census
a missing README at exact path is not the absence of other project documentation
reproducibility.future_extension: Pre-register 100+ agency/VFX/AI production provider URLs and independent human coder rubric, test canonical service pages and agent-host behavior separately; gather repeated quarterly measurements and failed predictions.
